basic_profile.bio: A curious tech enthusiast who recently discovered Reddit. Originally from San Francisco, I work as a junior software developer. I have a keen interest in TV shows, especially ones related to tech and startups, like Silicon Valley. I enjoy crafting and DIY projects in my spare time, often getting inspiration from online communities. Not a fan of overly complex tech jargon, I prefer straightforward discussions. I’m single and typically online during late evenings, after my workday.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a local university. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on projects and tutorials available online. I am a quick learner, especially when it comes to new programming languages and frameworks.
